lessons_used: Evidence is still thin to establish rules for specific kinds of changes, as no change type has been tested at least twice.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests conducted so far.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Warning Sign In Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the sign-in screen with high-visibility warnings explaining that pets are tied to this exact account login.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails about pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in drops off nearly 27% of users.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to Your Account
sign_in.body: Signing in anchors your pet to this account so your progress and custom pets are never lost across sessions.
sign_in.hint: Make sure to use the same login method each time to retain your pet.

guard.reason: Redesigns the sign-in screen clearly without removing required steps or violating design guidelines.

candidates.score_note: High evidence from emails and funnel, but redesign type previously showed negative lift.

candidates.title: Custom Pet Preview and Verification Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new verification screen before generating the final pet certificate to let users preview custom photo rendering results.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failing or outputting wrong visuals, and adoption step drop-off is over 39%.

new_pet_preview_check.headline: Preview Your Custom Desktop Companion
new_pet_preview_check.body: Check how your pet render looks before completing adoption.

guard.reason: Adds a custom pet preview screen within onboarding while keeping all required steps intact.

candidates.score_note: Targets high drop-off step, but introducing a new screen previously decreased conversion by 3.5%.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Interactive Tutorial Subflow
candidates.change: Add an interactive walkthrough sub-flow at the end of onboarding demonstrating how to show, hide, and summon the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Multiple support emails reported confusion on how to control/hide the pet or pet missing on desktop screen, and finish conversion is only 64.8%.

new_desktop_controls_walkthrough.headline: Master Desktop Controls
new_desktop_controls_walkthrough.body: Learn how to toggle visibility in your system tray and interact with your pet anytime.

guard.reason: Adds an interactive desktop controls tutorial subflow after the home intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong alignment with tickets and high finish drop-off, but adding a subflow incurs high implementation cost and extra friction.

candidates.title: Deferred Sign-In Post Pet Customization
candidates.change: Move sign-in after pet choice and customization so users build emotional investment before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users before they even see or customize their pet, taking an average of 567s.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in to take place after pet selection/customization, which is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Deferring sign-in builds intent before friction, though reordering requires significant flow changes.

candidates.title: Generation Wait Time and Status Tracker
candidates.change: Display a progress bar and accurate remaining time estimate on the waiting screen while pet assets render in the background.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s (over 38 minutes), leading users to believe the app stalled or failed to launch.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Desktop Companion
waiting.body: We are generating your desktop pet graphics and background setup.

guard.reason: Adds an accurate time estimate and progress tracker to the waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean duration (2336s) by managing user expectations during asset rendering.

candidates.title: Path Selection Clarification Copy
candidates.change: Rewrite headlines and choice descriptions to clearly distinguish quick preset pet adoption from custom photo pet creation.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s despite a 8s median, showing significant hesitation and confusion.

choose_path.headline: Choose How to Create Your Pet
choose_path.body: Pick a quick ready-made companion or upload photos to generate a unique custom desktop friend.
choose_path.hint: You can add more pets later from your settings.

guard.reason: Clarifies choices on the path selection screen while retaining both adopting and custom pet creation options.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost copy tweak addressing the large gap between median and mean time on path selection.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Technical Guidelines Hint
candidates.change: Add clear image requirements and framing advice hints to the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: Users complained about pet rendering errors and bad generation results in support tickets during photo upload.

upload_photos.hint: Use well-lit photos with clear subject backgrounds for best rendering results.

guard.reason: Adds helpful framing guidelines to the photo upload screen without altering its job.

candidates.score_note: Low cost hint targeting the step with the highest drop-off rate (39.1%) backed by support tickets.

candidates.title: System Tray Desktop Controls Callout Hint
candidates.change: Provide explicit instructions on finding the app icon in the system tray to control or unhide the desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support tickets highlight user confusion regarding how to bring back or hide pets after completing setup.

home_intro.hint: Look for the pet icon in your taskbar system tray to show, hide, or tweak settings anytime.

guard.reason: Adds system tray guidance hint to the home intro screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Simple hint intervention targeting 35.2% finish step drop-off and frequent support confusion.

candidates.title: Split Card Layout for Path Selection
candidates.change: Reformat the choose_path screen into a side-by-side split visual card layout.
candidates.why: The wide gap between median (8s) and mean (514s) time on choose_path indicates a cluttered or unclear decision presentation.

guard.reason: Reformats the path selection screen into a split layout while maintaining its functionality.

candidates.score_note: Layout reformat aims to resolve high mean time on path selection with moderate effort.

candidates.title: Background Rendering Desktop Notification Option
candidates.change: Enable desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen so users know they can safely minimize the window while waiting.
candidates.why: Home waiting takes 201s median and 2336s mean, causing users to close the app assuming it froze.

waiting.hint: Feel free to minimize this window. We'll alert you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!

guard.reason: Adds a desktop notification alert option to the waiting screen inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Helps prevent app closure during lengthy background rendering phase.
